fixes.area: empty St Georges Tce (peds + traffic do not reach the CBD camera)
fixes.problem: street_sgt still has 0 cars and 0 people; shops has 1 parked car. The code is in place (LOOPS.sgt, T.prime) but it never shows up. (1) peds.js S.update hides every ped with d2p > 340 m from the PLAYER (vis = d2p < 340). For camLocked views the player stays at EQ (112,-168), and the street_sgt camera is about 528 m away, so all 12 sgt walkers are invisible. In play the same rule thins any street the camera looks down beyond 340 m. (2) T.prime picks a random lane and a random point on it 400 times. The 20-160 m forward half-disc is about 0.5% of the network area, so roughly 2 of the 11 wanted cars land. (3) 12 walkers on a 1.34 km loop is about 1 per 110 m, far below a CBD footpath.
fixes.fix: peds.js S.update: const fo = G.camLocked && G.focus ? G.focus : {x:px, z:pz}; use the distance to fo for the vis test, and keep the player distance only for flee and avoidance logic. Add S.prime(fo, camPos, camFwd): move sgt and eq walkers to loop waypoints 15-140 m from fo with dot(p-cam, fwd) > 0 (call it next to traffic.prime in shoot.mjs and on teleport). Recycle: every 1 s, a walker more than 220 m from fo jumps to a random waypoint 60-180 m away that is outside the view cone. traffic.js: precompute samples every 10 m along each usable lane, [x,z,h,li,d], once at create. T.prime filters those to 20-160 m and forward, shuffles, and places with the existing 14 m spacing until 0.6*target. sgt population on high 12 -> 24, low 5 -> 8.

PRIME_SAMPLER: 10 m lane samples filtered to band
